listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging fleet encounter featuring Fabricators that explode if more than two are present.

description: Introduces a difficult enemy fleet centered around Fabricators. The mod has been nerfed to be beatable, with changes prioritizing reaching 2 Fabricators and limiting producible DP to roughly double the fleet's expected amount.
